summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of IHEZA School Management System focusing on session persistence and role-based UI restrictions. All requested features are working correctly: session persistence after page refresh, role-based navigation filtering, and conditional button visibility based on user roles.
passed_tests: Session persistence - user stays logged in after page refresh (Student role verified)
Session persistence - user data (name, role) preserved correctly after refresh
Student role navigation - only sees Dashboard, Students, Grades, Reports (4 items)
Student role navigation - Staff, Classes, Attendance, QR Check-In correctly hidden
Teacher role navigation - sees all 8 navigation items (Dashboard, Students, Staff, Classes, Attendance, QR Check-In, Grades, Reports)
Add Student button - hidden for Student role
Add Student button - visible for Teacher role
Edit/Delete student actions - hidden for Student role (shows 'View only' label)
Edit/Delete student actions - visible for Teacher role
Add Staff button - visible for Director role
Add Staff button - visible for Principal role
Add Staff button - hidden for Teacher role
Logout functionality - correctly redirects to home page
Session cleared after logout - protected routes redirect to login
Login with Student access code format (DUP/STU0001/2026)
Login with Teacher access code format (DUP/TEACHER/001/2026)
Login with Director access code format (IHEZA/DIRECTOR/001/2026)
Login with Principal access code format (DUP/PRINCIPAL/001/2026)
critical_code_review_comments: Redux session persistence implementation is correct - initializes state from localStorage in getInitialState()
ProtectedRoute correctly waits for authChecked before redirecting, preventing flash redirects
NAV_PERMISSIONS in Layout.js properly defines role-based navigation access
ROLES_CAN_REGISTER_STUDENTS and ROLES_CAN_MANAGE_STUDENTS in Students.js correctly control button visibility
ROLES_CAN_REGISTER_STAFF in Staff.js correctly limits Add Staff button to director and principal roles
context_for_next_testing_agent: All role-based UI restrictions are working correctly. Session persistence fix has been verified. The app correctly filters navigation items and action buttons based on user roles. Student can only view data, Teacher can manage students, Director/Principal can manage staff.
